paper_title: The PVLAS experiment: measuring vacuum magnetic birefringence and dichroism with a birefringent Fabry-Perot cavity
notes: Laboratory optical (LSW-type / vacuum birefringence) experiment measuring vacuum magnetic birefringence and dichroism, casting model-independent limits on ALP two-photon coupling. Exclusion plot (Fig. 14) shows g (GeV^-1) vs axion mass (eV) at 95% c.l., valid for both scalar and pseudoscalar ALPs. Data points are approximate reads from the log-log plot axes ranges (mass 1e-4 to ~1e-2 eV, coupling 1e-8 to 1e-5 GeV^-1); the ellipticity limit dominates above ~1 meV. Values are rough estimates since no numerical table of the exclusion curve is provided.
